newsitem.title: USA: Texas spot electricity gains strength from natgas.
newsitem.headline: Texas spot electricity gains strength from natgas.

text.p: Spot wholesale electricity prices in the Electric Reliability Council of Texas (ERCOT) were said to have climbed slightly Wednesday, following higher spot natural gas prices in the state, industry sources said.
Spot Texas gas rose about 25 cents to just over $3.50 per million British thermal units on Wednesday.
ERCOT firm, peak power for Thursday delivery was pegged at $30.00-32.00 from $29.00-31.00 on Tuesday, the brokers and marketers said.
Non-firm peak ERCOT power was pegged at $26.00-28.00 per megawatt hour (MWh).
Firm off-peak ERCOT power transactions were pegged at $16.00-18.00, the sources said.
Non-firm off-peak ERCOT power was assessed at $13.00-15.00 per MWh.
ERCOT January/February peak power prices were said to be holding steady at $29.75-30.25, the sources said.
